files.document_title: Wisconsin Department of Agriculture, Trade and Consumer Protection, Agricultural Impact Statement addendum for the Lakeshore Lateral pipeline project (AIS 4381), Appendix A Figure 1, PDF page 19
files.what_it_shows: A topographic overview map dated October 19, 2020 titled We Energies Lakeshore Lateral, Walworth, Racine and Kenosha Counties. It draws the approved mainline as a thin black line from the west edge near Town of LaGrange and Town of Sugar Creek east through Elkhorn, Town of Lafayette, Town of Spring Prairie, Burlington, Town of Dover, Union Grove and Town of Yorkville toward Town of Paris, with the route modification areas SIG-04 and SIG-05 marked. The map frame is cropped, so the far west end near Whitewater and the far east end near Mount Pleasant are not both visible. The line is thin and a georeferencer will need to zoom in.

searched: The oilandgaswatch crosswalk has no record for this row, so there were no attached documents.

Web search for the Lakeshore Lateral route map and Public Service Commission of Wisconsin docket 6630-CG-138, which found the Agricultural Impact Statement addendum from the Wisconsin Department of Agriculture and two local news items.
Opened the Agricultural Impact Statement addendum and rendered its Appendix A route map.
Did not open the Public Service Commission docket documents for 6630-CG-138; the department map already meets the map-good standard.
A 2018 Somers village web page carries a We Energies map image for the original proposal along County Highway KR; not downloaded because it shows the pre-approval alternatives.
notes: The map is an overview of the approved route as of the 2020 route changes, not a design drawing. The route is about 46 miles from the Bluff Creek Gate Station on the east edge of the Town of Whitewater to a regulator station near Interstate 94 in Mount Pleasant, per local news and the docket. Only the central part of the route is in the frame. The pipeline is under construction, and the department notes SIG-04 and SIG-05 as the latest route changes. For a full route a second map from the Commission docket (case 6630-CG-138) would help, but it was not needed for map-good status.
